title: Drips a lot when pouring
text: Drips a lot when pouring. Cute black matte finish and sleek design. Comfortable to hold too. But when I pour coffee into my mug, it drips! Not just a drop, a constant dribble. So something is a little off with design. I would not order this again for that reason.

product_metadata.title: Fityou French Press Coffee Maker, Insulated 304 Grade Stainless Steel Insulated Coffee Press with 4 Level Filtration System, Keep Warm for 8 Hours, 34oz (1 Litre)
features: Keep Warm Up To 8 Hours: Made with 2-layer 304 stainless steel, adopt vacuum technology, this french press coffee maker can keep the coffee warm for up to 8 hours compared with other cheap coffee maker. You can enjoy the fragrant coffee without worry it getting cold.

More thicker, More heavier, Build to last: French Press coffee maker is made from top quality 18/10 stainless steel, both the interior and exterior. It is made to outlast other coffee maker,to be shatter-proof and rust-resistant. A terrific gift for coffee and tea lovers!

3-Level Filtration Systems: Newly upgraded filtration systems based on the original French press coffee maker technology. The 0.18mm filter holes provide you with a cup of coffee like those made by professional baristas, our double stainless steel filters are strong enough to ensure the grounds doesn't get into your cup and make delicious, smooth, full flavor coffee.
Large Capacity(34 Oz/1 L): The keep warm function(up to 8 hours) and the large capacity can make you enjoy a whole working time without interrupting work just for making coffee.

Multiple Uses & Perfect for any occasion: Besides using the french press as a coffee maker, it is also handy appliance to make tea, mct oil coffee, hot chocolate, cold brew, frothed milk, almond milk, cashew milk, fruit infusions, and plant and herbal drinks as it seals in their flavors and aromas, for house warmings, weddings, birthdays, holidays and travelling.
